init.description: Give the ports and the EDIDs a name of your own. Empty fields keep the default name.

input_labels.description: These names replace "HDMI 1" and so on when you select the input of an output, are added to the name of the EDID and HDCP entities of the input and are available as a sensor.
input_labels.name: Inputs

output_labels.description: These names are added to the name of the output and are available as a sensor, for example as a heading in a dashboard.
output_labels.name: Outputs

edid_labels.description: These names replace the descriptions of the matrix when you select the EDID of an input. Every field is labelled with the description the matrix uses.
edid_labels.name: EDIDs

edid_list_fallback.description:
Home Assistant could not read the list of EDIDs from the web interface of {name} at http://{host}/ and offers a built-in list instead, which may not match the firmware of your matrix.

The integration tries again every 15 minutes and on every start, and this message disappears once it succeeds. Make sure that the web interface of the matrix is reachable from Home Assistant.
edid_list_fallback.title: {name}: EDID list could not be read
